Azúcar's keeping a secret 🤫💋 We're finally unveiling OUR OWN burlesque troop — Sappholicious — debuting at the Sapphic Sugar Cabaret, hosted by La Bon. Mama, it's about to get sultry. Think seductive choreo, straight-up pool table tricks (yes, you read that right), and comedy sharp enough to leave your jaw on the actual floor. Who's performing? Ni idea todavía — you gotta pull up to find out. All-inclusive cast, unrefined and bold energy, feathers flying and heels clicking on that pool table like it's nothing. Esta noche Azúcar se transforma en cabaret, and once La Bon steps on stage, todo cambia. This is a debut — meaning it only happens like this once. Don't be the one hearing about it Saturday morning. Grab your ticket, gather your people, and get ready to gasp out loud. Sapphic Sugar Cabaret doesn't wait for stragglers, mama.

📅 Saturday, August 22 • 9PM • Main Floor
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15-$35

Dim lights, red velvet energy, and heels clicking against a pool table like it's the most natural thing in the world 🎱💃 That's the vibe La Bon is bringing to Azúcar with the Sapphic Sugar Cabaret — Sappholicious, our brand new burlesque troop, making its debut. Picture slow reveals, sultry stares, corsets and confidence, punchlines landing right between the shimmies. It's unrefined. It's seductive. It's bold. The room's gonna smell like perfume and anticipation, la música baja pero la tensión sube, and every set builds until you can't help but gasp out loud. Comedy cuts through just when you think you've caught your breath, then the next act pulls it right back out of you. Nobody's telling you the lineup — you feel your way through it live, cariño. This isn't a show you watch from the back; it's one that gets under your skin.

Come exactly as you are, porque tonight's stage belongs to everybody 💗🎭 Sappholicious is Azúcar's very own burlesque troop, debuting the Sapphic Sugar Cabaret hosted by La Bon, and it's built to be all-inclusive from the cast to the crowd. Sultry, funny, a lil unexpected (pool table tricks, anyone?) — this show's for the ones who show up for community as much as for the spectacle. Bring your people, bring your best cheer, and get ready to hype up performers who are about to leave everybody's jaw on the floor. No pretension, no judgment, just a room full of us celebrating art, bodies, and a little bit of chaos together. Esta es una noche donde todos caben — the shy ones, the loud ones, the ones who came just to watch and the ones who came to be seen. Azúcar's Main Floor is yours tonight. Claim it.
